text: I bambini non vedevano l'ora di partire.

tr.en: The children couldn't wait to leave.

tr.en: Were you planning to leave early?

tr.en: Guys, were you thinking of me too?
tr.nl: Jongens, dachten jullie ook aan mij?

text: Noi venivamo qui a mangiare la pizza.

tr.en: We used to come here to eat pizza.
tr.nl: Wij kwamen hier altijd pizza eten.

tr.en: Where were you coming from?

tr.en: How long had they been waiting?

tr.en: We'll tell dad tonight.

tr.en: We'll tell him to wait.

tr.en: Will you think badly of me?

tr.en: We'll think about it tomorrow.

tr.en: We'll always think of you.
tr.nl: We zullen altijd aan jullie denken.

tr.nl: Dit boek zullen we nooit begrijpen.

tr.en: We'll talk tomorrow, okay?

text: I bambini non sentiranno il telefono.

tr.en: The children won't hear the phone.

tr.en: Will you watch the children tomorrow?

tr.en: Will you look for a house with a garden?

tr.en: We'll try not to be late.

tr.en: Will you look for a house in Rome?

text: Cercherete le uova in giardino domenica.

tr.en: On Sunday you'll look for the eggs in the garden.

tr.en: The children will ask for an ice cream, as always.

tr.en: Will they get to know Rome in a week?

tr.en: I'll serve the tea in these cups.
tr.nl: Ik serveer de thee in deze kopjes.

tr.en: You'll serve the wine, okay?

tr.en: You'll serve the coffee in the garden.
tr.nl: Jij serveert de koffie in de tuin.

tr.en: We'll serve the cake after dinner.

tr.en: On Sunday we'll serve breakfast in the garden.

tr.en: Where could the keys be?

tr.en: Will you want a coffee after lunch?

tr.en: You won't want to go out in this weather, will you?
tr.nl: Je wilt toch niet naar buiten met dit weer?

tr.en: On Saturday we'll want to help grandma in the garden.

tr.en: Will you stay for dinner with us?
tr.nl: Blijf je bij ons eten?

tr.nl: Jij blijft thuis bij de baby.

tr.nl: Vanavond blijven jullie thuis bij opa en oma.

tr.en: They'll stay with us for a week.
tr.nl: Ze logeren een week bij ons.

tr.en: Will our aunt and uncle stay for lunch?
tr.nl: Blijven oom en tante lunchen?

tr.en: Will you have a coffee with me?
tr.nl: Drink je een kopje koffie met me?

tr.en: You'll drink water, not wine.
tr.nl: Jij drinkt water, geen wijn.

text: Loro berranno il caffè dopo pranzo.

tr.en: They'll have coffee after lunch.
tr.nl: Ze drinken koffie na de lunch.
